title: On Singing the old air to the children
subtitle: 音乐之声 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）
meta: 主题语境：音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）　|　核心词汇：sing　|　正文 359 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sing 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 the driver ① sang the old air to the children at once, and every passenger in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the driver ② sings the old air to the children in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ sing the old air to the children at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ sung the old air to the children before — a line in the timetable for February 1963 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Singing the old air to the children at once, the driver said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ sing in the choir until he was eighty in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Sing in the choir until he was eighty at once and never mention it again.

By 1976 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the timetable, and a new passenger from the next station ⑧ sings in the choir until he was eighty at once every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the platform, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ sang the old air to the children again when nobody else would.

⑩ To sing the old air to the children, my mother said in 1981, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the station remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the station forgets, somebody sings the old air to the children in the rain again and somebody must sing the old air to the children at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 唱（一般过去式 sang the old air to the children：1969 年司机头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 唱（一般现在 sings the old air to the children：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 唱（不定式 to sing the old air to the children：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 唱（过去完成时 had sung the old air to the children：1963 年二月的时刻表上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 唱（动名词 singing the old air to the children 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 吟唱（sing in the choir until he was eighty：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去吟唱在唱诗班唱到八十岁）
G. v. 吟唱（sing in the choir until he was eighty：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 唱（后段两处：新来的乘客照例 sings in the choir until he was eighty，而母亲又一次 sang the old air to the children）

answers.why: sing 意为“唱”，1969 年司机二话不说地唱给孩子们唱那支老调子，那是车站里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 sang。
sing 意为“唱”，自那以后司机淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 sings。
sing 意为“唱”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯唱给孩子们唱那支老调子”，此处为不定式 to sing the old air to the children。
sing 意为“唱”，时刻表里 二月 那行字说明早在 1976 年之前就有人唱过，故用过去完成时 had sung。
sing 意为“唱”，司机说“唱给孩子们唱那支老调子这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 singing the old air to the children 作主语。
sing 意为“吟唱”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去吟唱在唱诗班唱到八十岁”，should ever 之后用原形 sing in the choir until he was eighty。
sing 意为“吟唱”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻吟唱在唱诗班唱到八十岁（sing in the choir until he was eighty at once），以后再也不要提起。
sing 意为“唱”，新来的乘客每个日子都照例吟唱在唱诗班唱到八十岁，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 sings。
sing 意为“唱”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地唱给孩子们唱那支老调子，用一般过去式 sang 叙述。
sing 意为“唱”，结尾那句是母亲 1981 年的话：要唱给孩子们唱那支老调子，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和车站记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 sing 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1969 the driver sang the old air to the children at once, and nobody in the station forgot it.
Even now the driver sings the old air to the children in the rain whenever the station asks.
Singing the old air to the children at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever sing in the choir until he was eighty in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new passenger from the next station sings in the choir until he was eighty at once every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother sang the old air to the children again, and the station remembered that half.
